query:
SELECT id, parentName, kidName, email, phone, createdAt 
FROM leads 
WHERE parentName LIKE '%Jordan%' OR email LIKE '%jordan.lee%' OR email LIKE '%example.com%'
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
